plz add the details of this patch like others in https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/main/vllm_ascend/patch/__init__.py

This makes the code very clear! 👍

# Experience value constants for profiling chunk prediction
MAX_HISTORY_LEN = 8          # Max profiling history samples for fitting
MIN_FIT_POINTS = 5           # Min data points required for reliable fitting
MAX_ONLINE_FIT_POINTS = 30   # Max online calibration points before marking fitted

class ProfilingChunkPredictor:
    """Predict optimal chunk size based on profiling data."""

    def __init__(self):
        self._history = []
        self._fitted = False

    def _fit_latency_model(self, history):
        """Fit quadratic latency model from profiling history."""
        L = min(len(history), MAX_HISTORY_LEN)
        recent = history[-L:]

        seq_lengths = [h.seq_len for h in recent]
        latencies = [h.latency for h in recent]

        num_points = len(seq_lengths)
        if num_points < MIN_FIT_POINTS:
            return default_chunk_size

        if num_points > MAX_ONLINE_FIT_POINTS:
            self._fitted = True

        # ... 拟合逻辑 ...
        return coeffs
